comparator.name: Theology
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh2November2026currentguideandcurrentlylinkedstudyguideindex verified. OrdinaryDutch2026entrant/no-prior-Greek route, not optionalBibleTranslation. Current 2026–2027 study guide freshly retrieved and inspected on 9 October 2026. The ordinary Dutch confessional-Reformed bachelor remains a three-year 180-EC degree; the optional Bible Translation route is not selected for this generic target. Printed p.36 explicitly labels first year cohort 2026 and independently totals 60 EC across ten positive-credit curriculum rows; only that supported subset is counted. Contact/integration activities marked X have no current awarded credits. PPV course p.37 says 2.5 EC at the end of the bachelor, not 2.5 annually or on top of the first-year 60. Students with prior Greek have specified replacement options and an examination obligation; the ordinary no-prior-Greek formation is retained, without adding replacement electives. The second-year table printed p.55 also bears cohort 2026 and totals 60: themedays1, church history5, Christian ethics5, OT exegesis5, NT exegesis5, Greek4/5 five, Hebrew4/5 five, introduction exegesis5, mission5, pastoral/church-education5, worship5, creation/redemption/consummation5 and elective4. This separately published table is evidence, not an additional certified 60 for this first-year cohort: Greek4 also appears in the first-year Greek1–4 row, while the general overview labels cohorts 2026/2025. Their applicable sequence and non-overlapping language requirements require clarification. Printed p.33 new-cohort overview shows third-year dashes and permits a 30-EC minor replacing shaded theological modules; it does not give current third-year weights. Printed p.77 detailed third year is explicitly cohort2024, with 27.5-EC replacement minor and thesis10 including methodology. Neither outgoing thesis10 nor outgoing minor27.5 is imported into the 2026 entrant. Replacement-minor and theological continuation requirements are alternatives; the full theological set is expected for students continuing to the TUA master, not compulsory plus an additional minor for all students. A complete current-cohort 180-EC reconstruction is not established. No UCR feasibility conclusion is drawn. Additional verified first-year conditions: Academic Skills is required before written assignments from period2; Greek2 requires Greek1 classes, Greek3 requires Greek1 passed/Greek2classes, Greek4 requires Greek1/2passed andGreek3classes; Hebrew2requiresHebrew1classes andHebrew3requiresHebrew1passed/Hebrew2classes. Planned first-year sequence satisfies these. Generalguideprinted25requires75%attendance. Printed46describesintegration2EC at endBT3, unlikeX-onlyyear1table; preserve this future allocation question,do not add2EC tofirst-year60.
